title: Island Sunset Cruise 2 Hour Catamaran Tour in Marathon Florida
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Cruise into a stunning Florida Keys sunset aboard a comfortable 53’ catamaran. Your crew will guide you through the waters surrounding Marathon, passing local landmarks such as Boot Key Harbor, the Atlantic Ocean, and the historic Seven Mile Bridge.

Relax on deck and enjoy the changing colors of the sky while sipping a complimentary champagne toast. The catamaran offers plenty of seating, shaded areas, an onboard restroom, and a cooler stocked with ice, water, and soda.

This tour provides a laid-back and memorable way to experience the Keys at golden hour—perfect for couples, families, and anyone who wants to unwind on the water.
